text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The Yasuda Kinen is almost here...! 
Oguri-senpai is without a doubt the 
strongest opponent. I'll train to the 
absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh— I really gotta thank 
Oguri-senpai...! Thanks to her, I've 
gotten this fired up—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see...! I get it now! I know what 
Oguri-senpai means to me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Yasuda Kinen, 
Oguri-senpai was in top form! Not only 
that, she even told me, "Let's make this a 
great race!"!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oohh! I'm burning up! I won't lose!! And 
I'll show Yaeno in this race just what 
kind of person Oguri-senpai really is!!
